Subject: Compliance add-on price construct + question on amortizing fees

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo this week — the team at CuraHealth liked Redwood's latency profile. Procurement asked that I send a concise breakdown of the compliance/security add-ons you discussed (audit logs retention tiers, KMS/HSM options, and multi-region residency).

Two specific asks from finance:
- If we commit to a 12-month guaranteed spend for Dedicated capacity, what volume rebate bands do you offer for the compliance bundle (audit logs + KMS + residency)?
- We have a preference to capitalise implementation/setup fees. Can Redwood amortize the one-time HIPAA onboarding / HSM provisioning fee over year 1 in the pricing schedule so our P&L shows it as OPEX?

I attached our internal compliance checklist (cura-compliance-ask-2026-07.pdf) to help map features.

Appreciate a short written summary we can share with the procurement lead.

Best,
Sarah

CuraHealth

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Compliance add-on price construct + question on amortizing fees

Hi Sarah — thanks for the checklist, that helps.

Short answers up front:
1) Yes — we can provide staged volume rebates tied to a committed annual spend. Typical bands start at 10% for a $500k+ compliance spend, 15% at $1M+, and 20% at $2M+. We treat the compliance bundle (audit logs + KMS seats + residency premium) as a single line for rebate qualification to keep contracting simple.

2) We can amortize onboarding/implementation fees across the first 12 months and reflect it as a monthly credit on invoices — not a capital invoice item from Redwood's side, but we will produce an invoice schedule that shows the implementation fee spread across months for your accounting.

Notes & options:
- Audit logs: retention tiers (90/365/730 days) priced per GB-month with tiered discounts at scale.
- KMS/HSM: two options — managed HSM seats (per-VPC seat) or bring-your-own HSM licensing (reduced monthly fee + integration charge). We recommend managed seats for the pilot; if you commit to a 12-month term we can step down the per-seat fee in the rebate schedule.
- Residency: per-region residency premium (applied to throughput & storage). For US-only deployments we can waive the multi-region surcharge for the first 6 months on committed capacity.

I'm looping in Marissa from pricing to propose a concrete rebate/amortization schedule and a sample invoice layout. Would you be available for a 30-min call Thursday to walk procurement through the table?

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1-415-555-0199

Lukas / Marissa — I drafted a rebate + amortization sketch for CuraHealth and attached the spreadsheet (rebate-schedule-v1.xlsx). High level:

- Rebate bands (compliance bundle spend per year):
  * <$500k: no rebate (intro pricing)
  * $500k - $999k: 10% rebate on compliance line items
  * $1M - $1.99M: 15% rebate
  * $2M+: 20% rebate + 60-day implementation credit

- Implementation/onboarding fee: one-time $120k for HIPAA onboarding + HSM provisioning. Option A: invoice up-front with a 12-month amortization credit of $10k/month on invoices. Option B: split 50/50 — $60k up-front, $60k amortized (we can do whichever aligns with their accounting).

- KMS/HSM: base managed-seat $2,500/seat/month; at 20+ seats drop to $1,900/seat/month. If they commit to 12 months at 20 seats we offer an additional one-time credit of $15k to defray provisioning.

- Residency premium: 8% uplift on base throughput + storage for the US-residency bundle; we can cap it at a fixed $X/mo for the pilot to avoid surprises.

I've kept the model modular. Sarah — if you prefer, I can convert Option A/B into an amortized invoice schedule that shows net monthly charge (after rebate + amortization) so finance can see the P&L impact.

Ben
